request.style: English, solo male baritone voice, warm and steady, acoustic guitar, cello, light percussion, harp, solemn and reverent mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The sons of Merari are known by name
Mahli and Mushi carry the load
From the tribe of Levi’s holy line
In the wilderness they stand

[Verse]
Frames of the tabernacle heavy and strong
Crossbars and posts in the dust
Bases and pegs and ropes all along
The work of the tent they must trust

[Chorus]
Carry the frames and the crossbars too
The posts and the bases of wood
Assigned by name what each man must do
For the service of the Lord’s house

[Verse]
Thirty years old and up to fifty
Fit for the work of the tent
Under the oversight of Ithamar
The priest’s command is meant

[Chorus]
Carry the frames and the crossbars too
The posts and the bases of wood
Assigned by name what each man must do
For the service of the Lord’s house

[Bridge]
Mahli and Eder and Jeremoth
Three sons in the record so clear
The clan of Mushi serves with might
Through the generations near

[Outro]
Frames and bases in the dust
The Levites’ faithful trust
